response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT AlbumId, UnitPrice, Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds AS bpm FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bpm) AS avg_bpm FROM t) SELECT t.AlbumId AS AlbumId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(t.bpm) AS AvgBytesPerMs, AVG(t.bpm) - overall.avg_bpm AS DiffFromOverall FROM t CROSS JOIN overall GROUP BY t.AlbumId ORDER BY DiffFromOverall DESC LIMIT 10;
